confirmed_current_findings: run_histopath declares a histopath_duplicate_aware_auc promotion contract but passes no group_values to _run_vision, so make_vision_splits currently returns stratified_kfold rather than a duplicate-aware split.

_run_vision selects checkpoints without TTA for the current ordinal, multiclass, multilabel, and binary-AUC runners, then produces final OOF and test predictions with TTA when tta_flips=True; checkpoint selection and deployment recipes therefore differ.

run_ranzcr passes PatientID groups when available, but make_vision_splits uses ordinary GroupKFold for multilabel grouped data; it does not balance labels and does not preflight whether every label is scoreable in every fold before expensive training.

build_jigsaw_promotion_gate compares a fold-locally rank-normalized blend against raw-probability base AUCs, so its claimed minimum blend improvement is not an apples-to-apples component-blend comparison.

run_birds trains the 19 per-species CatBoost channels on CPU before starting the GPU pair channel, leaving an allocated A40 unused unless CPU feature/species work is separated into a reusable precompute stage.
run_aptos uses the generic square resize and random crop pipeline without retina-specific black-border removal or illumination normalization.
run_dog_breed uses row-stratified folds without checking or grouping exact duplicate images, leaving duplicate leakage unmeasured and missing a low-cost exact-match deployment path.
_run_vision always trains every configured epoch and has no bounded early-stopping rule, which is especially inefficient for the 1821-image Plant Pathology task and other expensive vision folds.
run_whale protects exact waveform duplicates with SHA256 grouping and test overrides, but has no fold-clean near-duplicate acoustic fingerprint channel.
stale_findings_rejected: Rejected: the current vision runners silently fall back to random initialization. _vision_model requires pinned pretrained weights, verifies each cache-file SHA256, and fails closed if loading fails.
Rejected: the current vision tasks use a single holdout. _run_vision constructs complete multi-fold OOF predictions through make_vision_splits.

Rejected: the current RANZCR runner is non-grouped. run_ranzcr supplies PatientID and make_vision_splits selects GroupKFold when those groups are present; the remaining defect is lack of multilabel-stratified grouping and preflight.
Rejected: the current Jigsaw evidence is non-OOF. run_jigsaw uses iterative multilabel folds, predicts each training row only from its held-out model, and verifies the fold manifest.
Rejected: the current Whale CV ignores exact duplicates. make_whale_duplicate_aware_splits uses waveform SHA256 groups and fails on conflicting labels.
Rejected: current Bird and Whale test predictions come from a single fold. Both runners average predictions from all fold models.

campaign_arithmetic.conclusion: The eight supplied tasks alone cannot produce 18/22. Reaching 18 requires converting at least four of the eight previously scored non-medals. Their current source was not supplied and is therefore not audited or optimized here.

audit_summary.estimate_boundary: All probabilities below are planning priors for the incremental upgrades, not medal claims. Only private-grader output can establish an official medal.

confirmed_source_defects: run_aptos has no retina-specific preprocessing; it sends uncropped images through the generic forced-square resize and RandomResizedCrop path.
_run_vision selects the best APTOS checkpoint using a single-view validation score but computes final OOF predictions with flip TTA.
_run_vision has no early stopping, so every APTOS fold runs all configured epochs even after its best checkpoint is established.
already_implemented_strengths: run_aptos uses the pinned EfficientNet-V2-S ImageNet weights and fails closed on a missing or mismatched weight file.
APTOS uses stratified multi-fold OOF predictions rather than a single holdout.
Ordinal thresholds are cross-fitted for promotion scoring and refitted on all OOF predictions only for test deployment.
The gate checks that all five classes occur in every validation fold.
Vertical flips are disabled for retinal images.
highest_value_upgrades: Add deterministic retina cropping based only on image pixels: remove near-black borders, pad to a square, and apply bounded illumination normalization before the existing train/evaluation transforms.
Make checkpoint validation use the same TTA recipe as final OOF inference, or disable TTA consistently for both selection and deployment.
Add patience-two early stopping after a minimum of four epochs while retaining the best host-memory checkpoint.
Do not add a larger backbone; EfficientNet-V2-S at 512 pixels already provides the better A40-hour tradeoff and fits the 48GB limit.
validation_contract: A synthetic retina image with a black frame must be cropped to the non-black support without changing its label or reading any test metadata.
Every training row must have exactly one fold assignment and one finite OOF probability vector.
Every validation fold must contain classes [0,1,2,3,4].
Cross-fitted threshold records must fit thresholds on rows outside the scored fold.
Checkpoint-selection TTA must equal final-OOF TTA in the recorded budget.
The submission diagnosis column must contain only integers from 0 through 4 in sample-submission order.
per_competition.stop_rule: Run only seed 42, at most five folds and ten epochs per fold, with patience two after epoch four; stop APTOS optimization after one retina-preprocessing comparison or 3.0 A40 hours, whichever comes first.

confirmed_source_defects: run_dog_breed does not hash or group duplicate training images before row-stratified CV.
run_dog_breed has no exact train-to-test image match channel even though such a channel can be implemented without private labels.
_run_vision selects Dog Breed checkpoints without flip TTA and deploys them with flip TTA.
_run_vision has no early stopping across the expensive five-fold, ten-epoch ConvNeXt-Small run.
already_implemented_strengths: The runner derives the exact 120-class output order from the sample submission.
It uses pinned ConvNeXt-Small pretrained weights, 384-pixel inputs, channels-last tensors, AMP, fused AdamW when available, and A40 fast kernels.
It disables label smoothing for the log-loss objective.
OOF and test probability rows are checked to sum to one.
Vertical flips are disabled.
highest_value_upgrades: Compute train and test SHA256 image manifests before splitting; pass training hashes as groups and record duplicate counts and fold-overlap assertions.
For exact train-test image matches with one unambiguous breed, blend a clipped one-hot match prediction through a predeclared fold-clean validation protocol.
Add a bounded penultimate-embedding nearest-neighbor component and select its blend weight from a fixed five-value grid using only OOF fitting rows.
Align checkpoint-selection TTA with final inference and add patience-two early stopping.
Keep ConvNeXt-Small rather than escalating the backbone; a larger model would increase the already high 384-pixel five-fold A40 cost.
validation_contract: No SHA256 image group may occur in both the fitting and validation rows of a fold.
Every label.csv breed must map to exactly one sample-submission class.
Every training row must receive one finite 120-class OOF vector whose sum is one within 1e-6.
Every test row must receive one finite 120-class vector whose sum is one within 1e-6.
Any exact-match override must have one and only one public training breed and must be clipped away from zero and one.
The embedding blend weight for each held-out fold must be selected without using that fold's labels.
per_competition.stop_rule: Use seed 42 only; evaluate at most the logits-only baseline and one fixed five-weight embedding blend, stop after 4.5 A40 hours, and do not escalate to a larger backbone.

confirmed_source_defects: run_histopath supplies no group_values, so its current split strategy is stratified_kfold despite the promotion contract being named histopath_duplicate_aware_auc.
run_histopath caps training at 174464 rows by balanced random subsampling and discards the remaining public labeled images.
_run_vision selects Histopath checkpoints without TTA and computes final OOF and test predictions with TTA.
Duplicate safety is not represented as a required promotion check, allowing a nominally duplicate-aware gate to pass with row-wise folds.
already_implemented_strengths: The transform preserves center geometry by taking a fixed center crop before augmentation.
The runner uses pinned EfficientNet-V2-S weights, three folds, mixed precision, and a large A40-compatible batch.
The output uses a complete fold ensemble and finite clipped probabilities.
The gate requires both aggregate AUC and every-fold AUC thresholds.
highest_value_upgrades: Hash every public training image and pass exact-image hashes as group_values to _run_vision; require a grouped split in the promotion gate.
Use all public training rows unless a predeclared wall-clock cap is reached; if a cap remains necessary, sample complete hash groups rather than individual rows.
Add an exact public train-to-test hash override only when the public training labels within the hash group are unanimous.
Use identical TTA for checkpoint selection and final inference, with patience-two early stopping.
Retain EfficientNet-V2-S at 192 pixels; the primary gain is duplicate-safe data use, not a larger backbone.
validation_contract: The recorded split strategy must contain group and the group manifest must be based on public image SHA256 values.
No image hash may occur in both train and validation partitions of any fold.
Every training row selected for the run must receive exactly one finite OOF probability.
Both target classes must occur in every validation fold.
The promotion gate must contain and pass an explicit duplicate_group_disjoint check.

per_competition.stop_rule: Do not execute the current runner. After the duplicate-aware patch, run seed 42 once with at most three folds, six epochs, and patience two; stop after 3.0 A40 hours even if the internal gate misses its threshold.

confirmed_source_defects: cross_fit_multilabel_rank_blend creates held-out blend predictions from ranks recomputed within each held-out fold, while build_jigsaw_promotion_gate compares that blend against raw-probability base AUCs.
The reported minimum blend improvement can therefore include fold-rank normalization effects instead of only word/character blending.
run_jigsaw serializes both large vectorizers, all models, and all ratios for every fold even though only final submission generation and compact reproducibility evidence are required.
already_implemented_strengths: The target contract is explicitly restricted to the exact six official toxicity columns.
The runner uses iterative multilabel stratification and verifies complete OOF coverage.
Word and character TF-IDF vectorizers are fitted only on each fold's training rows.
Blend weights are selected away from each held-out fold.
Submission predictions are aligned to sample order through an explicit one-to-one ID join.
The model is CPU-based and consumes effectively no A40 training time.
highest_value_upgrades: Normalize word, character, and blended OOF components under the same cross-fitted rank protocol before computing base AUCs and blend improvement.
Make deployment normalization mirror OOF normalization by ranking each fold model's test component before averaging, then applying the final predeclared blend.
Evaluate a bounded NB-SVM C grid of [1.0,2.0,4.0] using only fold-clean OOF fitting rows and retain one selected C per label/analyzer.
Store compact vectorizer hashes, model coefficients, ratios, fold indices, and predictions instead of repeatedly compressing complete redundant fold objects.
validation_contract: The target columns must equal [toxic,severe_toxic,obscene,threat,insult,identity_hate] in that order.
Every training row must occur in exactly one held-out fold and every label must contain both classes in every validation fold.
Word, character, and blend promotion AUCs must all be computed from predictions processed by the same fold-clean normalization function.
No C value or blend weight may be selected using labels from the fold it predicts.
Sample and test ID sets must be equal, unique, and aligned by an explicit one-to-one join.
All six submission columns must be finite and strictly between zero and one.
per_competition.stop_rule: Perform one seed-42 run over the fixed three-value C grid and 21-value blend grid; stop after that run or 0.1 A40-equivalent hours, with no transformer escalation and no private-score-driven retry.

confirmed_source_defects: run_birds performs all per-species CatBoost training on CPU inside the same runner before using the A40 for pair models, reducing medal conversion per reserved A40 hour.

cross_fit_binary_auc_blend uses fold-specific deployment weights for OOF rows but a single all-OOF weight for test rows; although fold-clean, this can create fold-dependent score scales under the pooled pair metric.
The independently trained species probabilities are blended directly into a pooled recording-species AUC despite potentially different probability scales across species.
already_implemented_strengths: The runner verifies the official fold-0/fold-1 recording manifest and complete recording-species sample grid.
It skips unknown labels and fails if observed train or test IDs diverge from the official split.
Supplemental features are aligned by explicit recording IDs and declare that private labels are unused.
Audio feature extraction is cached across runs.
Both species and pair channels produce complete OOF predictions, and blend selection is cross-fitted.
The official pooled recording-species binary AUC reduction is implemented explicitly.
highest_value_upgrades: Separate audio feature extraction and CPU species-channel fitting into a resumable CPU-only precompute artifact, then request the A40 only for pair-channel folds.
Add fold-clean monotonic calibration or pooled rank normalization so species-channel predictions are comparable across species before blending.
Evaluate one additional predeclared pair model with depth 6 and class-balanced training, then cross-fit a two-component pair blend.
Do not increase feature width or add an audio neural network until the current cached-feature CatBoost variants have been exhausted.
validation_contract: Observed train IDs must exactly equal official fold-0 IDs and test IDs must exactly equal official fold-1 IDs.
The sample must contain exactly one row for every test-recording and species-0-through-18 pair.
No unknown or fold-1 label may enter truth construction.
Every training recording must receive exactly one finite 19-column OOF prediction.
Calibration and blend parameters for a held-out fold must be fitted only on other folds.
The CPU precompute artifact must be keyed by source feature fingerprints, seed 42, fold manifest, and target manifest.
per_competition.stop_rule: Reuse one seed-42 CPU precompute, run at most two predeclared GPU pair configurations, and stop after 0.9 A40 hours or after one configuration clears the frozen internal gate.

_run_vision selects Plant checkpoints from single-view validation predictions but computes final OOF and test predictions with flip TTA.

It uses pinned ConvNeXt-Small weights at 448 pixels with mixed precision and A40 fast kernels.
The promotion gate checks exact four-class mean AUC and a minimum AUC for every class.

highest_value_upgrades: Use a lesion-preserving transform that resizes while preserving aspect ratio and obtains a full-frame padded square rather than relying only on RandomResizedCrop.
Reduce to three stratified folds, retain ten as a hard epoch cap, and add patience-two early stopping after epoch three.
Use the same horizontal/vertical TTA recipe for checkpoint selection and final inference.

resource_schedule: Do not launch against the currently busy A40. First deploy the reviewed release under the pinned bundle SHA256 and retain the dedicated writable remote root.
Before each GPU stage, require the existing three consecutive idle samples to pass; do not weaken the utilization, memory, or compute-process checks.
After the release and source tests pass, run the corrected Jigsaw task as a CPU-only stage without reserving the A40.
Precompute and cache Whale and Bird audio features, hashes, supplemental alignment, and Bird CPU species artifacts before reserving the A40 for their CatBoost GPU stages.
Run Whale next with a 0.5-hour A40 cap, followed by Birds with a 0.9-hour cap.
Patch and run duplicate-aware Histopath with a 3.0-hour cap, then the three-fold Plant run with a 1.8-hour cap.
Run retina-preprocessed APTOS with a 3.0-hour cap, followed by duplicate-audited Dog Breed with a 4.5-hour cap.
Run RANZCR last because it has the lowest estimated incremental gain per A40 hour; require grouped multilabel preflight before its 7.5-hour capped stage.
After each task, validate and freeze its submission, OOF artifact, fold manifest, source hash, weight hashes, seed 42, and budget record before deleting checkpoints or moving to the next task.
Present all valid frozen submissions and internal gates to the Human Gate. No automatic Kaggle or private-grader submission is permitted.
Record official private-grader outputs only as campaign outcomes; do not feed them back into model, hyperparameter, fold, calibration, or blend selection.

After all eight are officially scored, recompute the official medal count. Even an eight-for-eight result reaches only 14/22, so request authoritative current source for previously scored non-medals before proposing the four additional conversions required for 18/22.
global_stop_rules: Preserve seed 42 for every external run; derived fold seeds already used by the source are allowed, but no external seed sweep is allowed.
Never start a GPU task until the three-sample idle gate passes and the dedicated remote root remains writable.
Stop all execution if the deployed source hash, pinned bundle hash, pretrained-weight hash, official data manifest, or sample-submission contract differs from the frozen record.
Do not promote any vision result with incomplete OOF coverage, train-validation group overlap, non-finite predictions, or a mismatch between checkpoint-selection and final inference recipes.
Use only predeclared bounded model grids and task-specific GPU-hour caps; do not escalate backbone size on the A40 during this wave.
An internal promotion-gate failure stops further optimization for that task but is not interpreted as an official non-medal; a valid submission may proceed only through the Human Gate.
An internal promotion-gate pass is not a medal claim and must retain official_grader_executed=false until an actual official grader result exists.
Make at most one Human-approved official scoring action per frozen task artifact in this campaign; do not use the returned private score to choose or retrain a model.
Do not claim that the eight unscored tasks can achieve 18/22: their mathematical ceiling is 14/22 from the current 6 medals.
Do not audit or recommend changes for the previously scored tasks until their authoritative current source is supplied; stale historical findings are not admissible.
